6.description: [Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] Reduced the duration of the Holy Ground damage over time effect to 6 seconds down from 8 seconds.

[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] The Maiden of Virtue now has a new ability called Seal of Virtue. Seal of Virtue causes the melee attacks of The Maiden to apply a stacking damage over time effect to her target. Lasts 30 seconds stacking up to 100 times.
[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] Removed the raid warning for Blessing of Martyrdom.
[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue]  The Maiden of Virtue now has a proper boss warning when casting Desperate Prayer.
[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] Corrected an issue where the Maiden of Virtue was able to auto attack in between her Desperate Prayer pre-cast and the actual Desperate Prayer.

[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] The Maiden of Virtue will no longer delay her abilities while casting Desperate Prayer. She will now reschedule them when the cast ends. This causes all of her abilities to be more predictable.

[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] The Maiden of Virtue will now cast her first Desperate Prayer 40 seconds into combat instead of 20 seconds. The repeat timer is still 40 seconds. The repeat timer will now start ticking at the end of the cast rather then start of the cast.
[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue]  Blessing of Martyrdom will now deal fixed damage.
[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] Consecration now deals fixed damage. The % maximum health damage has been reduced to 12% on Flex Normal and 20% on all other difficulties.
[Karazhan] [Maiden of Virtue] Repentance no longer deals damage. Repentance now ignores any form of invulnerability and can no longer miss.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Reduced the healing done by Lady Catriona von Indis Greater Heal to 30% maximum health down from 50%.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Reduced the Weapon damage dealt by Lord Robin Daris Mortal strike to 100% down from 150%.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Reduced the healing done by Lady Keira Berrybucks Holy Light to 15% maximum health down from 25%.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Added 4 additional food plates to the room.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Will no longer delay his other abilities when he vanishes. This should make all of his events more predictable.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Moroes will now start his vanish CD when he leaves stealth and not upon entering, increasing his up time before he vanishes again by 4 seconds to a total of 30 seconds.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Soul Burst now stacks up to 100 times up from 10.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Starving now stacks up to 200 times up from 100.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Invulnerability will no longer remove Dinner Is Served. Invulnerability will still remove Starving and prevent Starving from stacking for their duration.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Blind now has 30 yard range and will no longer target Moroes current target.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Corrected an issue where Outraged would break Moroes out of stealth.

[Karazhan] [Moroes] Moroes now has a new ability called Backstab. Moroes will periodically attempt to Backstab his target. Backstab is only successful if the target has turned its back to Moroes and inflicts 200% weapon damage.
[Karazhan] [Moroes] Moroes will no longer use Gouge.
[Karazhan] [Attumen and Midnight] Exploit prevention will now be active on all difficulties.
[Karazhan] [Attumen and Midnight] Corrected an issue where FelFireballs Felfire had a larger radius then the Felfire spawned by Charge.
[Karazhan] [Attumen and Midnight] Spectral Charger summoned during Attumens Phase 2 now move at default movement speed in Flex Normal difficulty.
[Karazhan] [Attumen and Midnight] Attumens Charge ability can now target out of line of sight. Charge can no longer miss.

[Karazhan] [Attumen and Midnight] Intangible Presence now has 45 yard range on all difficulties. Intangible Presence now lasts for 15 seconds up from 10 on Flex Normal difficulty. Intangible Presence can no longer miss. Intangible Presence no longer ignores invulnerability.
[Karazhan] [Attumen and Midnight] Devastating Strike has its damage reduced to 50% weapon damage down from 100%. Devastating Strike can no longer miss and now ignores any form of invulnerability.
[Karazhan] [Attumen and Midnight] Shadow Cleave now hits all targets in front of Attumen. Shadow Cleave will now be reduced by area damage reduction. Shadow Cleave no longer targets pets.
[Karazhan] [Attumen and Midnight] Attumen will now use Intangible Presence every 30 seconds. Previously was on a random timer 25 to 45 seonds.
[Karazhan] [Attumen and Midnight] Attumen will now use Devastating Strike every 15 seconds. Previously was on a random timer 20 to 45 seconds.
[TBC Raids] [General] All Creatures within Karazhan, Gruuls Lair and Magtheridons Lair no longer follow the parry hasten rules.
[TBC Raids] [General] All bosses within Karazhan, Gruuls Lair and Magtheridons Lair now see trough invisibility and stealth.
[TBC Raids] [General] Increased the physical damage dealt of all creatures on Flex Heroic difficulty by 50%.

[System Change] [Raids] Flex Normal is aimed towards random groups. Flex Heroic is aimed towards organised groups and guild groups. Ascension 10 and Ascension 25 is aimed towards those player that seek a true challenge to proof their skills.
[System Change] [Raids] All raids are now available in 4 difficulties: Flex Normal, Flex Heroic, Ascension 10 and Ascension 25 Player.
[System Change] [Items] With the new Ascended quality of items, player will experience an increase in the item level of all Heroic and Ascended items, better reflecting the items power.
[System Change] [Items] Player that already own a Heroic Item will have them automatically converted into its Ascended version.
[System Change] [Items] All Raid Items now exist in their Normal version, Heroic version and Ascended version.

0.description:
The nightmare mode aura in dungeons no longer increases all damage taken by 100%, instead it now increases all damage taken by 50%, reduces healing done and absorbs done by 25% and reduces your damage dealt by 25%. (This is identical to the raids)

This change is to help prevent bursty one-shot mechanics in dungeons and overall help improve your overall nightmare dungeon experience.
Fixed an issue related to the nightmare mode in raid auras causing some spells to lose more than 25% damage from the aura nightmare mode raiding applies.
